title: ARDP: AMOC Reanalysis Diagnostic Pipeline
description: Python code for computing the overturning freshwater transport at 34.5S (F_ovS) from ocean reanalyses (ORAS5, GLORYS12V1, SODA 3.15.2, ECCO-V4r4) and CMIP6 output, decomposing its change into velocity-driven and salinity-driven contributions, and producing the figures and tables of the accompanying article.
